newsitem.title: INDIA: India SBI GDR pre-marketing from Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: India SBI GDR pre-marketing from Sept 16.

text.p: India's largest commercial bank, the State Bank of India (SBI), will begin pre-marketing its $400 million issue of global depositary receipts (GDRs) on September 16, investment banking sources said.
The roadshows were scheduled to begin around September 23 with pricing some ten days later, market sources told Reuters.
They said SBI had applied for a waiver of the 20 percent government cap on investments by foreign insitutional investors in the equity capital of Indian banks.

The bank had said in its application that the government requirement in the SBI Act -- which stipulates that the Reserve Bank of India's holding should not fall below 55 percent -- would not be violated.
